reasons: CS3230 is a must-take course but its prerequisite (CS1231 or CS1231S or MA1100T or MA1100) is satisfied by completed modules CS1231S. However, CS3230 also requires (YSC2229 or CS2040S or CS2040 or CS2040C or CS2040DE or CS2040HS). CS2040S requires CS1231S (completed). So CS3230 can be taken after CS2040S. In the previous plan, CS2040S was in Sem 2, so CS3230 could be in Sem 3. The previous plan missed CS3230 entirely.
CS3281 is offered in Sem 2 only. Semester 5 is Sem 1 of Y3S1. Therefore, CS3281 cannot be taken in Semester 5.
CS4261 is offered in Sem 1 only. Semester 6 is Sem 2 of Y3S2. Therefore, CS4261 cannot be taken in Semester 6.
